purpose: Formalize the native information-validity problem exposed by P0R, audit nearest methods, and freeze only future solver requirements.

legally_observable_or_derivable: the agent's own past legal observations and actions
cache age induced by native sensing time and the unmodified tau_max rule

native_decision_variables.scout_sensing: u[s,k] in {0,1}: scout s senses objective k; each scout selects at most one native objective action per step.
native_decision_variables.terminal_service: z[d,k] in {0,1}: terminal d selects native objective action k; each terminal selects at most one action per step.
native_decision_variables.relay_control: absent: relays currently have no transition-effective non-idle action and may not be represented as a controllable P1 variable.

native_hard_constraints: z[d,k] <= eta[d,k], where eta[d,k] is the existing native fresh-token predicate.
eta[d,k] = 1 only if a valid routed token exists and current_step - t_sense <= tau_max.
z[d,k] = 0 for completed objectives and for every action masked by the native environment.
each role obeys its existing per-step action cardinality and action-mask interface.
no freshness penalty may replace a native infeasibility mask.

formal_scope.objective: feasibility first; among native-feasible sensing-service choices, optimize only an objective explicitly derived from existing mission completion/progress and existing safety semantics.

solver_requirements_if_a_future_solver_i: deterministic input-output behavior under a fixed legal history
explicit certificate of native feasibility or infeasibility
separate G_t^P from G_t^V rather than using only a scalar freshness penalty
no privileged future topology or failure information
a stated structural property to prove before performance claims
no claim that a generic shortest-path or greedy age rule is the requested high-ceiling solver
literature_audit_axes: UAV information freshness / AoI trajectory and scheduling
multihop AoI routing and deterministic scheduling
prohibitions: algorithm naming beyond the descriptive candidate scope
